en.quote: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
en.riddle: Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
en.speaker: David

he.quote: וַיַּעַן דָּוִד וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶֽהָ
he.riddle: הִנֵּה חֲנִית הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיַעֲבֹר אֶחָד מֵֽהַנְּעָרִים וְיִקָּחֶֽהָ
he.speaker: דָּוִד

en.22: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
